title: GUITAR HERO: WORLD TOUR GAME FOR PLAYSTATION 3 PS3, DISC, CASE, MANUAL
descriptionText:
Experience the thrill of rocking out with Guitar Hero: World Tour for Sony PlayStation 3. This game disc comes complete with case and manual, making it the perfect addition to any fan's collection. Jam out to your favorite tunes with the T-Teen rated game, featuring a vast selection of songs and the ability to play with up to four people. 

Join the Guitar Hero Series and become a rock star with this action-packed game. Released in 2008 by Activision, Guitar Hero: World Tour is a must-have for any music game enthusiast. This game is compatible with NTSC-U/C (US/Canada) region codes and offers an exciting adventure for players to embark on.
